traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Kewaceae: leaves whorled, alternate or opposite; leaves simple; veins single; blades linear; stipules present; leaf rosettes terminal; plants hermaphrodite; ovary superior; floral cup absent; stems herbaceous; flowers actinomorphic; perianth tepals; fruit capsule; stamens 5 to 15 (-20); carpels 3 to 5. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.

traits.perennation.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Kewaceae: how its perennial herbs last from year to year (character 25), coded usually a rhizome. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py with character 25 added); states the authors do not qualify, side by side, read as often.
